task_text: Put the 1.5 mL tube from the plate into the centrifuge's rotor, in the slot opposite the tube that is already there, without turning the rotor.

inventory: centrifuge (Eppendorf 5430 model), lid open, with a 30-slot rotor
two 1.5 mL tubes with screw caps (one in the rotor, one in the plate)
